children: Eaton has signed an agreement to acquire electrical power distribution solutions developer Col Group from Oaktree Capital Management for an enterprise value of 810 million euros, or about $923.1 million.

The deal aims to expand Eaton's power distribution capabilities and manufacturing footprint in Europe, helping it support growing customer demand across data center and utility markets, the power management company said Friday.

Col Group provides medium-voltage electrical distribution solutions, including switchgear, grid automation technologies and modular power systems. It has facilities in Turin, Milan, Bergamo and Catania, Italy. The company has forecast sales of EUR250 million for 2027.
The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027.
